calculation.description: Cross-asset beta-neutral residual reversal, risk scaled by 20-session residual volatility and conditioned by a causal VIX stress z-score. VIX stress is the clipped deviation from its trailing 120-session median divided by trailing robust MAD; all windows are backward-looking. Positive factor values indicate expected higher forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was positive in all available evaluated regimes: 2026-2028 +0.048958 (354 dates), 2029-2031 +0.024167 (523 dates), and 2032-2035-08-01 +0.030585 (783 dates). No 2023-2025 observations were available because the VIX-aligned factor did not meet its causal warm-up requirements. Interpret small-universe IC uncertainty conservatively.
